movies.title: Range 15
movies.description: When the world drops dead overnight, a hard-living crew wakes up to a brand-new rulebook: survive, improvise, and never go quietly. With the undead crawling out of every shadow and a last-ditch rendezvous point on the map, they blast through chaos with grit and gallows humor. Welcome to the end times—population: anyone dumb enough to still be standing.

movies.title: Check Point
movies.description: A stranded outsider stumbles into a sleepy town—and straight into a conspiracy that doesn’t want witnesses. As rumors turn to gunfire and friends turn into targets, one determined woman becomes the difference between a cover-up and the truth. It’s a pressure-cooker thriller where every road leads to a checkpoint… and not everyone gets through.

movies.title: You Can't Have It
movies.description: A seductive stranger, a picture-perfect life, and a secret that doesn’t stay buried. When obsession moves in and boundaries vanish, desire twists into danger—and the cost of saying “no” keeps rising. In this slick, modern suspense tale, love is a trap… and someone always pays for what they want.

movies.title: Going to America
movies.description: Chasing a fresh start, a dreamer hits the road with big hopes and bigger expectations—only to discover the journey is the real test. Between culture shocks, close calls, and the kind of strangers you only meet in movies, ambition collides with reality at every turn. A wild ride about reinvention, resilience, and the price of wanting more.

movies.title: Samurai Cop 2
movies.description: The legend is back—and so are the lunatics. When a new wave of crime hits the streets, a renegade cop with a killer instinct and a flair for the dramatic returns to finish what he started. It’s neon-soaked mayhem, outrageous fights, and revenge served with a straight face… and a very sharp edge.

movies.title: Non-Stop to Comic Con
movies.description: One trip. Zero chill. A band of misfits barrels toward the biggest fan event of the year—only to face breakdowns, blowups, and the kind of chaos you can’t cosplay your way out of. Packed with convention energy and road-trip disasters, it’s a backstage pass to friendship, fandom, and surviving the ride.

movies.title: A Blood Story
movies.description: In a city where secrets drip from every alley, a single night of violence ignites a chain reaction of betrayal. As bodies pile up and loyalties turn inside out, survival becomes a game of timing—and trust becomes lethal. A pulpy, midnight-thriller descent into the kind of blood debt that never stays paid.

movies.title: The Coed and the Zombie Stoner
movies.description: Finals week gets a lot harder when the campus starts eating itself. A fearless coed and her unlikely sidekick—a perpetually baked survivor with surprisingly good instincts—fight their way through dorm-room doom and undead party crashers. It’s horror, hilarity, and high-stakes survival… with extra brains on the side.

movies.title: Chicks Dig Gay Guys
movies.description: Behind the velvet rope of nightlife, friendships form fast—and get tested even faster. When personal dramas collide with big dreams and bigger personalities, the party becomes a battlefield of loyalty, love, and unapologetic truth. A sharp, cheeky ride through found family and fabulous complications.

movies.title: 5th Passenger
movies.description: Deep in space, oxygen is low, nerves are frayed, and the mission is already broken. When a trapped crew realizes someone—or something—doesn’t belong on board, paranoia becomes as deadly as the void outside. Claustrophobic, tense, and razor-tight, this sci‑fi thriller proves the worst enemy is the one you can’t eject.

movies.title: Our Way
movies.description: Two lives collide at the edge of change, where the past won’t let go and the future demands courage. As choices narrow and stakes rise, a determined woman refuses to be written into someone else’s ending. A tough, emotional story about taking the long road, holding the line, and doing it—no matter what—your way.

movies.title: Sister Code
movies.description: Sisters don’t just share blood—they share history, secrets, and the kind of love that can either save you or destroy you. When old wounds reopen and new threats step in, the bond gets tested under pressure. A fast, fierce drama about loyalty, survival, and the rules you break for family.

movies.title: Alpha House
movies.description: Welcome to the house where the rules are made up and the consequences are real. When a group of young women discovers the “perfect” place comes with an ugly underbelly, the party turns into a fight for control. Equal parts glossy and savage, it’s a thriller about power, pressure, and what happens when the mask slips.

movies.title: V/H/S/2
movies.description: A stack of tapes. A missing person. And footage no one was meant to see. Each recording pulls you deeper into a nightmare of urban legends, warped experiments, and things that move too fast in the dark. Hit play if you dare—because once you’ve watched, you can’t unsee what’s on the other side of the screen.

movies.title: Warfighter
movies.description: The mission ends, but the battle doesn’t. When elite operators return home carrying invisible scars, loyalty becomes the only compass in a world that no longer makes sense. Gritty and grounded, this modern war story explores brotherhood, sacrifice, and the cost of doing the job when the world sleeps.

movies.title: Abstraction
movies.description: In a world of curated realities and half-truths, one moment shatters the picture into sharp, dangerous pieces. As perception blurs and motives hide behind artful lies, a woman fights to separate what happened from what she’s being told happened. A sleek psychological thriller where the truth is the most unstable thing in the room.

movies.title: The Green Fairy
movies.description: One taste is all it takes. When a night out turns into a fever dream, temptation becomes a doorway—and something on the other side wants in. Drunk on mystery and drenched in neon, this dark tale spins seduction into superstition, where the “green fairy” doesn’t grant wishes… it collects them.

movies.title: The American Gandhi
movies.description: In a country addicted to noise, one voice tries to cut through with conviction. When ideals clash with politics, and peace becomes an act of rebellion, the fight turns personal. A provocative drama about principle under fire—where doing the right thing is the most dangerous move you can make.

movies.title: The Bitch that Cried Wolf
movies.description: In a town powered by gossip, one woman’s warning becomes everyone’s favorite punchline—until the threat is no longer a story. As suspicion spreads and the line between drama and danger disappears, survival means proving the truth before it’s too late. A sharp, wicked thriller where the real monster might be the crowd.

movies.title: Burying the Ex
movies.description: Breaking up is hard to do—especially when your ex won’t stay dead. A messy love triangle turns supernatural when the past literally claws its way back into the present. Romantic, ridiculous, and gloriously undead, it’s a horror-comedy about closure, second chances… and not answering the door after midnight.

movies.title: Evil Bong 4:20
movies.description: It’s the kind of buzz you don’t come down from. When a cursed bong returns to spread chaos, the highs get weirder, the kills get louder, and reality gets toasted beyond repair. Packed with stoner madness and creature-feature energy, this cult trip proves some smoke sessions end in screams.

movies.title: Evil Bong: High 5
movies.description: Just when you think it’s safe to light up, the evil returns for another round. The crew faces fresh hallucinations, fresh horrors, and a wicked little artifact that turns party time into survival time. It’s over-the-top, unapologetic, and proudly unhinged—because in this universe, the bong always wins.

movies.title: Gingerdead Man vs. Evil Bong
movies.description: Two cursed icons enter. Only one gets the last laugh. When a homicidal cookie and a demonic bong collide, the showdown is baked in blood and drenched in smoke. It’s a gloriously ridiculous monster mash where the only thing higher than the body count is the insanity.

movies.title: The Oatmeal Man
movies.description: Breakfast just got brutal. When a creepy local legend steps out of the shadows, a simple routine turns into a full-blown nightmare. As fear spreads and bodies drop, a woman must outsmart something that’s been watching for a long time. Strange, sinister, and wildly unpredictable—this is comfort food turned killer.

movies.title: Despair Sessions
movies.description: A group therapy experiment promises healing—but what it really delivers is exposure. When secrets surface and pressure spikes, the line between self-improvement and self-destruction snaps. Dark, tense, and painfully honest, it’s a descent into what happens when you can’t escape your own mind—or each other.

movies.title: After School Massacre
movies.description: Detention. Locked doors. And a killer who doesn’t believe in extra credit. What starts as a harmless after-school hang turns into a frantic fight for survival as the halls become a hunting ground. A sharp slasher throwback with modern bite—because the last lesson of the day is: run.

movies.title: Misirlou
movies.description: One melody. Too many memories. When a haunting tune pulls a woman back into a past she tried to forget, romance and danger spiral together like smoke. Seductive and atmospheric, this noir-tinged tale turns longing into a weapon—and proves some songs don’t fade… they follow.

movies.title: Less Than a Whisper
movies.description: Some truths are spoken softly—because saying them out loud is deadly. When a woman uncovers something she was never meant to find, she’s forced into a world of quiet threats and loud consequences. A tense, intimate thriller where survival depends on staying one step ahead… and keeping your voice down.

movies.title: Casting Couch
movies.description: In a town built on illusions, the audition room is where dreams get made—and where they get broken. When ambition meets manipulation, a rising performer has to decide what she’ll sacrifice and what she’ll fight for. A sharp, dramatic look at power plays, high stakes, and reclaiming the script.

movies.title: Road Hard
movies.description: Life on the road is loud, lonely, and always one bad decision away from disaster. When a burnt-out comic hits the circuit for a comeback, the laughs come with bruises—and the lessons come at last call. A raw, funny ride through faded fame, fresh failures, and the grit it takes to keep going.

movies.title: 7 Faces of Jack the Ripper
movies.description: The legend is back—wearing a new face every time. When a string of brutal killings echoes the past, a woman is pulled into a maze of clues, disguises, and fear. Each suspect is a mask, each alley a trap, and the truth cuts deeper than any blade. Classic mystery vibes with a blood-soaked twist.

movies.title: Babes Behind Bars
movies.description: Locked up, fired up, and done playing nice. Inside a prison where the rules are cruel and the power is corrupt, a crew of women fights back with brains, bravado, and grit. It’s pulp, rebellion, and razor-wire attitude—because freedom isn’t given… it’s taken.

movies.title: King of the Nerds (TBS)
movies.description: Brains, bravado, and a crown up for grabs. A group of lovable outsiders competes in high-energy challenges where strategy matters as much as personality. Alliances form, rivalries flare, and confidence gets forged in real time—because being a nerd isn’t a weakness… it’s the edge.

movies.title: Take Me Out (FOX)
movies.description: Lights up, hearts on the line. In this fast, flirty dating showdown, one contestant faces a wall of potential matches—and one wrong move can cut the power. It’s bold choices, instant chemistry, and big reactions, where confidence is currency and the spotlight never forgives.
